_comment: SRE Dashboard — Hyperscale Log Monitoring · Post 23 · distrib-dotnet.substack.com
_description: Aggregates the four golden signals (latency, traffic, errors, saturation) from App Insights, Service Bus, and Event Hubs into a single operational view.
_deploy: az resource create --resource-group YOUR_RG --resource-type Microsoft.Portal/dashboards --name hyperscale-sre-dashboard --properties @docs/sre-dashboard.json
_import: Azure Portal → Dashboard → Upload · paste this JSON
name: hyperscale-sre-dashboard

0._comment: Tile 1: p99 latency — orders/create last 1 hour

inputs.name: Query
inputs.value:
requests
| where timestamp > ago(1h)
| where name has 'orders/create'
| summarize p99=percentile(duration,99), p50=percentile(duration,50)
  by bin(timestamp, 5m)
| render timechart

1._comment: Tile 2: Error rate — all services last 1 hour

inputs.name: Query
inputs.value:
requests
| where timestamp > ago(1h)
| summarize Total=count(), Errors=countif(success==false)
  by cloud_RoleName, bin(timestamp, 5m)
| extend ErrorRate = round(100.0*Errors/Total, 2)
| render timechart

2._comment: Tile 3: Order volume — traffic signal last 1 hour
2._alert_threshold: < 10% of baseline for 15 consecutive minutes (traffic drop indicates upstream issue)

inputs.name: Query
inputs.value:
requests
| where timestamp > ago(1h)
| where name has 'orders/create'
| summarize Count=count() by bin(timestamp, 5m)
| render columnchart

inputs.name: Query
inputs.value:
traces
| where timestamp > ago(1h)
| where message has 'DLQ non-empty'
| extend DLQ=toint(customDimensions.DeadLetterCount)
| summarize MaxDLQ=max(DLQ) by bin(timestamp, 5m)
| render timechart

4._comment: Tile 5: Polly retry rate — leading indicator for saturation
4._alert_threshold: > 5 retries per minute for 10 consecutive minutes

inputs.name: Query
inputs.value:
traces
| where timestamp > ago(1h)
| where message has 'Retrying order processing'
| summarize RetryCount=count() by bin(timestamp, 5m)
| render timechart

5._comment: Tile 6: Exception count by type — exception summary last 24 hours
5._alert_threshold: New exception type appearing that was not present yesterday

inputs.name: Query
inputs.value:
exceptions
| where timestamp > ago(24h)
| summarize Count=count() by type, cloud_RoleName
| order by Count desc
| take 10

6._comment: Tile 7: Dependency latency — SB and EH send times
6._alert_threshold: SB send > 500ms p99 for 5 minutes (indicates SB throttling)

inputs.name: Query
inputs.value:
dependencies
| where timestamp > ago(1h)
| where type in ('Azure Service Bus', 'Azure Event Hubs')
| summarize p99=percentile(duration,99) by type, bin(timestamp, 5m)
| render timechart

inputs.name: Title
inputs.value: p99 Dependency Latency — SB and EH

7._comment: Tile 8: Tenant order rate — business metric
7._note: Not a four-golden-signal metric — included for business context. Sudden drop in one tenant = tenant-specific issue.

inputs.name: Query
inputs.value:
requests
| where timestamp > ago(6h)
| where name has 'orders/create'
| where success == true
| extend TenantId = tostring(customDimensions.TenantId)
| summarize Count=count() by TenantId, bin(timestamp, 15m)
| render timechart
